We are looking for a sharp, accurate, and proactive professional to join an international high-tech company. 
 This is not a typical customer service specialist role. It is a complex B2B order management and logistics coordination position within the Business Operations team, which plays a key role in serving international clients. 
You will manage the full order process, from the moment a deal is closed until the final shipment of products to customers across Europe. 
You will work closely with account managers, logistics teams, and the company's headquarters in Asia, coordinating every step of the process.The role involves using multiple internal systems, tracking orders, ensuring accuracy, and solving any order or shipment issues. 
Because the products are highly technical, high value, and the systems are complex, this role requires someone who is sharp, analytical, and precise.Even a small mistake can have a large impact, so accuracy and attention to detail are essential. 
The work environment is fast-paced and international, with tight deadlines and frequent communication across different time zones.Mornings can be particularly busy, so you will need to stay calm under pressure and communicate clearly with both colleagues and customers. Requirements

jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for enthusiastic Order Pickers / Logistics Employees. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that millions of flowers and plants are delivered to the right customers on time every day. As an Order Picker, you play a key role in the logistics process. You make sure that flowers and plants are processed quickly, accurately, and delivered to the correct destination. Your responsibilities include:
- Picking and processing flower and plant orders.
- Transporting flower and plant trolleys throughout the auction warehouse.
- Sorting and distributing products to the correct locations.
- Checking orders for quality and quantity.
- Maintaining a clean and safe working environment.
- Working together with your colleagues to achieve the daily logistics targets.
You will use modern logistics equipment, such as an electric tug or order picking vehicle. Experience is not required, as full training will be provided. Working hours: Your shift starts at 06:00 AM and usually finishes at 12:00 PM, with occasional overtime until 1:00 PM.

- You are available at least 3 days per week.
- Monday and Friday availability is mandatory.
- You can start work at 06:00 AM in Aalsmeer.
- You are physically fit and enjoy active work.
- You work accurately and take responsibility for your tasks.
- You speak Dutch or English.

Finished your Bachelor Degree and looking for a job in the business sector? Send me a message to discuss your possibilities.

Conventional Lathe Operator

Conventional turning outdated? Not in our work!
Alongside CNC machining, conventional techniques continue to offer plenty of challenges.

You will perform turning operations on components up to Ø1,500 x 8,000 mm, weights up to 8,000 kg. Most parts are one-offs, requiring precise work, patience, and perseverance. 
First time right is more important than speed.
In addition to conventional turning, knowledge of 3-axis CNC milling is preferred. 
If you don’t have this yet, no problem! You are eager to learn and willing to develop these skills.

We understand that it can take 1 to 2 years for a new colleague to reach the desired level in our field. 

We start with a one-year contract, but aim to convert it to a permanent position as soon as possible.
We work daytime shifts, and a 4-day workweek is available if you prefer.

Requirements 
•    At least a level 3 vocational education (MBO 3) or equivalent; a completed qualification is a plus but not required.
•    Hands-on experience in machining.
•    Practical, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.

Personal qualities
•    Patient and persistent, with a strong work ethic
•    Thinks before starting a task
•    Works in a structured and precise manner, with a clear understanding of the job at hand
•    Able to work independently, but also thrives in a team environment
•    Speaks English
